title: 국회행정심판위원회규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:2:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7-2 (Designation and Operation of Electronic Information Processing System)
(1) The Committee shall designate and operate the National Assembly Secretariat Administrative Appeals System (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the "Administrative Appeals System") as the electronic information processing system under Article 52 (5) of the Act, so that persons intending to undertake administrative appeal proceedings can submit petitions for adjudication and other documents through information and communications networks and receive service of written rulings and various documents under the Act.
(2) A person intending to undertake administrative appeal proceedings through the Administrative Appeals System shall sign by means of an electronic signature under Article 2, subparagraph 2, of the Electronic Signature Act (meaning a signature enabling verification of the signer's real name), or by other electronic means recognized by other statutes or regulations for the purpose of verifying the person's identity. [Amended on December 9, 2020.]
(3) Where the Committee has posted a written ruling or other document to be served on the Administrative Appeals System, it shall notify the party of that fact by electronic mail or telephone.
